import pytest
from subject import (
    DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD,
    ModelEvalRegressionResult,
    check_eval_regression,
)


class _FakeSummary:
    def __init__(self, total_tasks: int, onex_worse_count: int):
        self.total_tasks = total_tasks
        self.onex_worse_count = onex_worse_count


class _FakeReport:
    def __init__(
        self,
        report_id: str,
        suite_id: str,
        total_tasks: int,
        onex_worse_count: int,
    ):
        self.report_id = report_id
        self.suite_id = suite_id
        self.summary = _FakeSummary(total_tasks, onex_worse_count)


def test_default_regression_threshold():
    assert DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD == 0.30


def test_model_eval_regression_result_summary_regression():
    result = ModelEvalRegressionResult(
        is_regression=True,
        worse_count=5,
        total_tasks=10,
        worse_ratio=0.5,
        threshold=0.3,
        report_id="report-1",
        suite_id="suite-1",
    )
    assert "REGRESSION" in result.summary
    assert "5/10" in result.summary
    assert "50%" in result.summary
    assert "30%" in result.summary
    assert "report-1" in result.summary


def test_model_eval_regression_result_summary_ok():
    result = ModelEvalRegressionResult(
        is_regression=False,
        worse_count=2,
        total_tasks=10,
        worse_ratio=0.2,
        threshold=0.3,
        report_id="report-2",
        suite_id="suite-2",
    )
    assert "OK" in result.summary
    assert "2/10" in result.summary
    assert "20%" in result.summary
    assert "30%" in result.summary
    assert "report-2" in result.summary


def test_check_eval_regression_invalid_threshold_low():
    report = _FakeReport("r1", "s1", 10, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="threshold must be in \\[0.0, 1.0\\]"):
        check_eval_regression(report, threshold=-0.1)


def test_check_eval_regression_invalid_threshold_high():
    report = _FakeReport("r1", "s1", 10, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="threshold must be in \\[0.0, 1.0\\]"):
        check_eval_regression(report, threshold=1.1)


def test_check_eval_regression_empty_report():
    report = _FakeReport("empty-report", "empty-suite", 0, 0)
    result = check_eval_regression(report)
    assert result.is_regression is False
    assert result.worse_count == 0
    assert result.total_tasks == 0
    assert result.worse_ratio == 0.0
    assert result.threshold == DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD
    assert result.report_id == "empty-report"
    assert result.suite_id == "empty-suite"


def test_check_eval_regression_no_regression():
    # worse_ratio = 0.2, threshold = 0.3 -> not regression
    report = _FakeReport("r1", "s1", 10, 2)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.3)
    assert result.is_regression is False
    assert result.worse_count == 2
    assert result.total_tasks == 10
    assert result.worse_ratio == 0.2
    assert result.threshold == 0.3


def test_check_eval_regression_regression():
    # worse_ratio = 0.4, threshold = 0.3 -> regression
    report = _FakeReport("r2", "s2", 10, 4)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.3)
    assert result.is_regression is True
    assert result.worse_count == 4
    assert result.total_tasks == 10
    assert result.worse_ratio == 0.4
    assert result.threshold == 0.3


def test_check_eval_regression_threshold_equal():
    # worse_ratio == threshold -> not regression (strictly greater required)
    report = _FakeReport("r3", "s3", 10, 3)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.3)
    assert result.is_regression is False
    assert result.worse_ratio == 0.3
    assert result.threshold == 0.3


def test_check_eval_regression_custom_threshold():
    # threshold = 0.5, worse_ratio = 0.4 -> not regression
    report = _FakeReport("r4", "s4", 10, 4)
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.5)
    assert result.is_regression is False
    assert result.threshold == 0.5

    # threshold = 0.5, worse_ratio = 0.6 -> regression
    report2 = _FakeReport("r5", "s5", 10, 6)
    result2 = check_eval_regression(report2, threshold=0.5)
    assert result2.is_regression is True
    assert result2.threshold == 0.5
